how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-silithus-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:8324:progress:0: Find any more encrypted texts? Bring me a good batch of them, this decoding work takes some time.
rows.quest:8324:completion:0: Excellent!  I can't wait to read these. Please do keep bringing the encrypted texts here if you find them.

rows.quest:8333:progress:0: If you need another Twilight cultist's medallion of station, then I am happy to oblige. I will, however, need another brilliant shard and some abyssal crests...
rows.quest:8333:completion:0: Here you are, ⟦1⟧. One more Twilight medallion of station. ⟦E1⟧ it well, and I wish you luck against the Abyssal Council!
rows.quest:8342:title: Twilight Ring of Lordship

rows.quest:8342:completion:0: Ah, I see your convictions are strong. Not many will face that council of fiends!⟦3⟧⟦4⟧Here's your ring, ⟦5⟧. May your will, and your fortune, stand firm.
rows.quest:8363:title: Abyssal Signets
rows.quest:8363:progress:0: You've shown you're more than capable of taking on an Abyssal Duke, ⟦6⟧. I'm always one to promote good habits. Bring me more signets and I'll give you a reward.
rows.quest:8363:completion:0: Excellent, ⟦7⟧!  Defeating those Dukes will leave the Twilight's ⟦E2⟧ reeling for a while. As promised, here's your reward. It's some of the better stuff Huum and I have found.
rows.quest:8364:title: Abyssal Scepters
rows.quest:8364:progress:0: You've truly exceeded all my expectations, ⟦8⟧. You've been taking on opponents that Huum and I would think long and hard before engaging.⟦9⟧⟦10⟧At this point the best I can do is to continue rewarding your efforts in the fight against the Twilight's ⟦E2⟧ and their overlords.⟦11⟧⟦12⟧Bring me more abyssal scepters and I'll do my best to give you a suitable reward.
rows.quest:8364:completion:0: I knew you'd come through, ⟦13⟧! Here's your reward.

rows.quest:8732:title: Field Duty Papers
rows.quest:8732:progress:0: I take it you want those papers signed, ⟦23⟧?
rows.quest:8732:completion:0: Yes, I suppose that little skirmish will pass as field duty nowadays. Take these back to Cenarion Hold, I'm sure they'll have a cushy job ready for you.⟦24⟧⟦25⟧Off you go!
rows.quest:1125:obj:0: Free the spirits of 8 Tortured Druids and 8 Tortured Sentinels in Southwind Village, and then return to Layo Starstrike at the Valor's Rest graveyard of ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:1125:details:0: To our southwest lies a tragic site - the ruins of Southwind Village. This is where our work should begin, ⟦26⟧.
rows.quest:1125:details:1: From what we've learned, this village was once a night elf base of operations for ⟦E4⟧. It's long since overrun by the silithid hives that infest the wastes. I can only imagine the horror of the village's initial sundering...
rows.quest:1125:details:2: The tortured spirits of fallen druids and sentinels wander the ruins aimlessly. Explore this locale, freeing the souls of these wretched beings as needed.
rows.quest:1125:progress:0: ⟦E13⟧ or ⟦E14⟧, it doesn't matter - no being deserves to be trapped on this world as a tortured spirit.  The freeing of these souls will make things right, ⟦27⟧.
rows.quest:1125:completion:0: I had thought that maybe the huge swirling hive near the ruins of the village had played a part in its demise. It would seem that your work has proven this to be correct; the proximity of the hive poses a ⟦E15⟧ to any future work we may do here.
rows.quest:1125:completion:1: I thank you for your benevolence in freeing the souls of the fallen; such work is never easy, I know. When you're ready, however, I'd like to ask for your assistance once more...
rows.quest:8277:obj:0: Beetix Ficklespragg at Cenarion Hold in ⟦E4⟧ wants you to gather 8 Stonelash Scorpid Stingers and 8 Sand Skitterer Fangs. Return to her when you have completed the task.
rows.quest:8277:details:0: Beetix Ficklespragg at your service! My cousin Noggle makes a living gathering rare herbs for Cenarion Hold alchemists. Or used to, anyway. He came back from his last trip with a strong poison running though his veins.
rows.quest:8277:details:1: I've managed to slow down the venom, but to fully neutralize it I need poison samples from whatever stung him.
rows.quest:8277:details:2: Noggle arrived from the north, so I'd bet my shirt stonelash scorpids or sand skitterers did it. Bring me some stingers and fangs and I'll try to make an antidote for him.
rows.quest:8277:progress:0: Are you done collecting those samples?  We could lose Noggle any minute now!
rows.quest:8277:completion:0: Cross your fingers, friend! Here's to hoping we can save Noggle!
rows.quest:8280:obj:0: Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in ⟦E4⟧ wants you to kill 15 Dredge Strikers.
rows.quest:8280:details:0: Cenarion Hold is a location of utmost strategic importance. I'm convinced that while we hold it our victory over the silithid is guaranteed. Provided our influx supplies can be maintained, that is.
rows.quest:8280:details:1: Desert worms have proven to be more of a ⟦E15⟧ to our supply caravans than even the silithid themselves. Just this morning, a large shipment of morrowgrain was ravaged by a group of dredge strikers. I need you to thin their numbers to ensure our supplies aren't jeopardized.
rows.quest:8280:progress:0: The dredge strikers are a serious ⟦E15⟧ and must be dealt with quickly!
rows.quest:8280:completion:0: You have my sincere gratitude. Your efforts in helping Cenarion Hold have shown true courage.
rows.quest:8804:title: Desert ⟦E16⟧ Kits
rows.quest:8804:desc:0: Bring 4 Globes of Water, 4 ⟦E17⟧ and 4 ⟦E18⟧ to Calandrath at the inn in Cenarion Hold in ⟦E4⟧. You must also bring ⟦E19⟧ in order to complete this quest.
rows.quest:8804:obj:0: Bring 4 Globes of Water, 4 ⟦E17⟧ and 4 ⟦E18⟧ to Calandrath at the inn in Cenarion Hold in ⟦E4⟧. You must also bring ⟦E19⟧ in order to complete this quest.
rows.quest:8804:details:0: Bring 4 Globes of Water, 4 ⟦E17⟧ and 4 ⟦E18⟧ to Calandrath at the inn in Cenarion Hold in ⟦E4⟧. You must also bring ⟦E19⟧ in order to complete this quest.
rows.quest:8804:completion:0: Excellent! We were in need of these, ⟦28⟧ . Thanks.
rows.quest:1126:obj:0: Scale the tower of Southwind Village and locate a means to stir the silithid hive into activity. Bring back anything unusual you may uncover when doing so to Layo Starstrike at the Valor's Rest graveyard of ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:1126:details:0: The hive needs to be addressed in Southwind Village, and I think I know a way to get at them. It's been my experience that the silithid hives are very sensitive to their environment; this explains their attacks when hearing the death wails of the spirits.
rows.quest:1126:details:1: The silithid are strongest in the tower - the one with the mass of wasps circling it. Scale the tower and jostle the hive into activity. Report back what you learn, but be careful! If you uncover anything that might help, bring it to me.
rows.quest:1126:progress:0: Well, did it work? You're still in one piece, which is good news. Did you find anything?
rows.quest:1126:completion:1: It has the shape of a... box, maybe? It's encrusted over something fierce. Wait, there a portion here that's exposed... is that a book underneath all this gunk?
rows.quest:1126:completion:2: I think you've stumbled across quite the find here, ⟦29⟧... well, at least I hope it is. Perhaps it is a journal or a log from ancient times, preserved in this shell.
rows.quest:1126:completion:3: I think I know a way to find out what this is.
rows.quest:6844:obj:0: Take the ⟦E20⟧ to Umber - the ⟦E6⟧'s archivist - in the village of Nighthaven, ⟦E21⟧.
rows.quest:6844:details:0: There's plenty to do here still, but I think taking this back to the Circle for analysis is key. Trust me - the work will still be here once this is all said and done. If it's a journal inside this sticky chitin, then the Circle would finally have a window into the past!
rows.quest:6844:details:1: Take this to the Circle's archivist in Nighthaven. His name is Umber, and the man's brilliant. Touched, sure, but brilliant nonetheless! Umber's salvaged tomes in far worse shape than this. If it can be saved, he can do it.
rows.quest:6844:progress:0: Why, hello there! Hrmm...⟦30⟧⟦31⟧Let me be a little honest with you, friend... you smell a bit ripe. Whiffy, one might say. Now I'm not making a personal assailment of your being. I'm just saying... in the future, you may want to freshen up a little after coming in from the field. It will make those first impressions a little more positively impressionable!⟦32⟧⟦33⟧Anyhoo... what can I do for you?
rows.quest:6844:completion:0: Well great monkey toads! What have you got here? It's sort of book shaped, I guess... I'll try crack this shell on it.
rows.quest:6844:completion:1: Layo sent you to me from ⟦E4⟧? I've only heard very hushed rumblings - which I guess aren't all that hushed when you think about it - about the horrors that are going on out there. Couple that with my lack of pleasure for anything bug-like, and you've got the recipe for me needing to stay here with the books!
rows.quest:8278:obj:0: Beetix Ficklespragg at Cenarion Hold in ⟦E4⟧ wants you to gather 3 Stonelash Pincer Stingers, 3 Stonelash Flayer Stingers and 3 Rock Stalker Fangs.
rows.quest:8278:details:0: Blasted! The antidote didn't work. Noggle must've been stung by one of the stronger creatures in the far south.
rows.quest:8278:details:1: I'm going to need you to go there and get me some more samples, ⟦34⟧. The good news is that since their poison is stronger I won't require as many. The bad news is that there are more kinds of poisonous creatures crawling around the southern area so you'll have to draw from more sources.
rows.quest:8278:progress:0: This is our last ⟦E22⟧ to save Noggle!  Hurry!
rows.quest:8278:completion:0: Yes! It seems to be working, Noggle is coming to. We owe ya big time!
rows.quest:8281:obj:0: Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in ⟦E4⟧ wants you to slay 20 Dredge Crushers.
rows.quest:8281:details:0: Your performance has been truly exemplary so far, ⟦35⟧. Our supply lines are not completely safe yet, however. In the absence of dredge strikers, their larger southern cousins will surely move in to take their place in the north.
rows.quest:8281:details:1: You'll have to kill quite a few dredge crushers to keep them at bay, but we cannot leave the safety of our supply lines to ⟦E22⟧.
rows.quest:8281:progress:0: The dredge crushers are a serious ⟦E15⟧ and must be dealt with at once!
rows.quest:8281:completion:0: Excellent! You've proven to be a valuable ally in preparing for the war against the silithid.
rows.quest:8319:title: Encrypted Twilight Texts
rows.quest:8319:progress:0: Keep bringing me texts.  We'll soon force the Twilight's ⟦E2⟧ out of ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:8319:completion:0: Excellent work!  I'll put a good word in for you.
rows.quest:8282:obj:0: Retrieve ⟦E23⟧ from the mountains in the south of ⟦E4⟧ and return it to him at Cenarion Hold.
rows.quest:8282:details:0: Where am I? Where's my bag? *gasp* I must've lost it while fleeing from Deathclasp, the giant scorpid. In my rush to escape I walked right into a nest of stonelash flayers.
rows.quest:8282:details:1: The satchel I was carrying had all sorts of rare reagents in it. Without them, me and Beetix won't be able to make the potions that Cenarion Hold needs. I'm too weak to get up yet, but I can make it worth your while if you bring back my reagents.
rows.quest:8282:details:2: I ran into Deathclasp in the southern mountain range, behind Bronzebeard's camp.
rows.quest:8282:progress:0: Still haven't found my bag?  Well I should count my lucky stars, at least the poison's been cleansed.
rows.quest:8282:completion:0: Yes! You brought my satchel back. And my rare reagents are all here! I'll be in your debt for a long time.
rows.quest:8284:obj:0: Geologist Larksbane at Cenarion Hold in ⟦E4⟧ wants you to collect 8 Twilight Tablet Fragments.
rows.quest:8284:details:0: A camp of Twilight's ⟦E2⟧ cultists once thrived northwest of here. If you were to venture there now, you'd find the area swarming with elementals and nothing but scattered pieces of wood and canvas to mark the spot where the camp was.
rows.quest:8284:details:1: I've recovered a few fragments of a clay tablet from the site, but I have too few of them to piece together anything useful. See if you can find the remaining tablet fragments so we can shed some light into the Twilight's ⟦E2⟧ presence here in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:8284:progress:0: The ravaged camp can be found northwest of here.  Come back when you have all the fragments.
rows.quest:8284:completion:0: Just as I suspected. I can decipher individual words in the tablets but they appear to be devoid of any logic or meaning. It's not unknown for Twilight's ⟦E2⟧ sects to use a code to hide the meaning of their texts; we'll have to go to someone who knows more about this sort of thing.
rows.quest:8283:obj:0: Bring ⟦E24⟧ to Vish Kozus, Captain of the Guard.
rows.quest:8283:details:0: The terrible scorpid, Deathclasp, is believed to have retreated to the southern mountain range in the presence of increased silithid activity. She presents a great ⟦E15⟧ to patrols and expeditions in the southern regions. Individuals participating in her destruction will be remunerated handsomely. Inquire with Captain Vish Kozus, at the top of the Cenarion Hold Watchtower, regarding a reward.
rows.quest:8283:progress:0: I'll need the creature's pincer as proof of the deed. No pincer, no reward.
rows.quest:8283:completion:0: Excellent! With Deathclasp gone we're free to use the southern mountain range as a strategic path to circumvent the silithid hives. Your work is greatly appreciated.
rows.quest:8285:obj:0: Take the restored tablet to Hermit Ortell in ⟦E4⟧.⟦36⟧
rows.quest:8285:details:0: There are rumors of a Twilight's ⟦E2⟧ member called Ortell having deserted his sect. Word has it he hid in the mountains south of Southwind Village, where he lives as a hermit. Perhaps you can enlist his help in deciphering the tablet.
rows.quest:8285:details:1: Take the restored tablet with you and seek out Ortell.
rows.quest:8285:progress:0: You!  How did you find me?  Who are you?  You weren't followed, were you?  Speak!
rows.quest:8285:completion:0: I see you're familiar with my old organization. You must be with Cenarion Hold.
rows.quest:8285:completion:1: You seek information to use against them? Come closer, perhaps we can be of mutual assistance.
rows.quest:8323:obj:0: Hermit Ortell wants you to bring him 10 Encrypted Twilight Texts
rows.quest:8323:details:0: Now that I have the Twilight Lexicon in my possession, there is a small favor I'd like to ask of you.
rows.quest:8323:details:1: My former organization has a secret encoded bulletin they circulate on a monthly basis.
rows.quest:8323:details:2: If they make any progress searching for me or if they call off the search, word will be published on the True Believer.
rows.quest:8323:details:3: Although this information is obviously valuable to me, the publication contains other useful information that I can share. Bring me any encoded texts you find on Twilight's ⟦E2⟧ members.
rows.quest:8323:progress:0: Did you find any encrypted texts?  I'm quite curious to read this month's True Believer.
rows.quest:8323:completion:0: Excellent! I will get to decoding these as soon as possible. If I find anything of interest I'll find some way to get the information to you.
rows.quest:8279:obj:0: Bring the three chapters of the Twilight Lexicon to Hermit Ortell in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:8279:details:0: The Twilight's ⟦E2⟧ are not kind to those that leave their ranks. They hunt me to this day like I'm some sort of beast! Needless to say, an ⟦E25⟧ of theirs is a friend of mine!
rows.quest:8279:details:1: To decipher this Tablet I'll need the book used by their scribes to encode secret messages: the Twilight Lexicon. It's such an important tool that they keep its three chapters in different locations! The officers entrusted with the Lexicon are known as Twilight Keepers, look for them at the Twilight's ⟦E2⟧ camps.
rows.quest:8279:progress:0: Who goes there?  Oh, it's you!  Did you find all the Lexicon chapters yet?
rows.quest:8279:completion:0: Yes! These are the parts to the book! Let's get started then, ⟦37⟧.
rows.quest:8279:completion:1: Swap every third word with words from the second chapter... then swap every other word with words from the first chapter... Wait, did I get that backwards?
rows.quest:8286:obj:0: Venture to the Caverns of Time in ⟦E26⟧ and find ⟦E27⟧, Brood of Nozdormu.
rows.quest:8286:details:0: The embrace of death had all but overcome my being when he intervened. He breathed only once upon my maimed body and then waited patiently for the sands of time to cleanse my ⟦E28⟧.
rows.quest:8286:details:1: B"Forever you will remain if you must", he said, and with those words I was bound as a Watcher.
rows.quest:8286:details:2: Look now to the desert. The second war is upon us. You must seek out the resting place of the Bronze. Venture to the Caverns of Time and see if the master has returned. I must be sure before I am able to proceed.
rows.quest:8286:completion:0: It is as it should be - the great one has risen. My watch comes to an end...
rows.quest:8287:obj:0: Take the Decoded Tablet Parchment to Commander Mar'alith.
rows.quest:8287:details:0: Ok, here we are... a pretty valuable chunk of information, I must say! I've seen the ⟦E6⟧ forces arrive at ⟦E4⟧. They plan to drive the Twilight's ⟦E2⟧ out, don't they? This will help.
rows.quest:8287:details:1: Take this parchment to their leader, Commander Mar'alith. Soon the Twilight's ⟦E2⟧ will be vanquished and I will be outside their grasp for good!
rows.quest:8287:progress:0: What is this you bring to me, ⟦38⟧?
rows.quest:8287:completion:0: This is very interesting information indeed, ⟦39⟧. This sheds some light on the presence of the Twilight's ⟦E2⟧ in ⟦E4⟧ and will undoubtedly help us in our struggle against them. Your efforts will be handsomely rewarded, ⟦40⟧.
rows.quest:8301:obj:0: Collect 200 Silithid Carapace Fragments and return to Baristolth.
rows.quest:8301:details:0: The Brood of Nozdormu are naturally distrusting of the lesser races. While it is true that you have proven to me that you have the potential makings of a hero, the time has come to prove this to my master.
rows.quest:8301:details:1: Hive'Ashi, Hive'Zora, Hive'Regal: All swarming with activity and all a ⟦E15⟧ to our existence. Slay silithid at these hives and take from them a fragment of their carapace. When you can carry no more, return to me and I shall strengthen your resolve.
rows.quest:8301:progress:0: There is much history rooted in their distrust of the mortal races; but alas, such is a tale better left for the Brood to tell when the time is right.
rows.quest:8301:completion:0: You are not alone, hero. I will now grant you the ⟦E29⟧ to deputize others to help you in your quest. If you are to be the champion of your people, you will need assistance in your tasks and duties.
rows.quest:8302:title: The Hand of the Righteous
rows.quest:8302:desc:0: Collect 200 Silithid Carapace Fragments and return to Baristolth.
rows.quest:8302:details:0: Choose your deputies wisely, mortal. Each time you return with your task complete, a new deputy you will be allowed to choose.⟦41⟧⟦42⟧With that said, I require more of the carapace fragments. Waste no time!
rows.quest:8302:progress:0: Perhaps one day the whole of Cenarion Hold will be working under your command.
rows.quest:8302:completion:0: Well done, hero. You will now be granted the ⟦E29⟧ to deputize another ⟦E30⟧.
rows.quest:8303:obj:0: Seek out ⟦E27⟧ at the Caverns of Time in ⟦E26⟧.
rows.quest:8303:details:1: I must apologize for keeping so much in secret. ⟦E31⟧ abound, even under our very noses. Please, read from this tome and learn. Take the knowledge I give to you and seek out our master.
